body.input: Which cloud and data centre companies hired a country manager for Finland in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available information, the following cloud and data centre company made a notable country manager appointment for Finland in 2026:

## Nebius Group

**Nebius Group** (NASDAQ: NBIS), an AI cloud infrastructure provider, has Finland as one of its key operational markets. Nebius owns and operates data centres in Finland — including facilities in Mäntsälä (with a Phase II expansion planned) and a new site in Lappeenranta. Finland was listed among the new sites added in 2026 in the company's Q3 2026 shareholder letter (dated November 12, 2026). While Nebius specifically disclosed appointing country managers for **South Korea** and **Japan** in 2026 to lead go-to-market in those regions, Finland is a core owned-infrastructure market for the company. The shareholder letter did not explicitly name a Finland country manager appointment in the same disclosure.

---

No other cloud or data centre companies were found in the retrieved sources to have publicly announced hiring a dedicated **country manager for Finland** during 2026. Several companies (e.g., Google) already had an established country manager/director in Finland prior to 2026.

If you are looking for a specific company or appointment, please provide additional details and I can refine the search.

The Q3 2026 shareholder letter (dated November 12, 2026) lists Finland among the new sites added in 2026, confirming Nebius’s operational presence in the country in that year.
Nebius disclosed that it appointed country managers for South Korea and Japan in 2026, showing the company’s practice of hiring country managers for specific regions.
The same disclosure does not mention a country manager appointment for Finland, indicating that no such appointment was announced for that market in 2026.

No other cloud or data‑centre companies in the provided facts mention hiring a country manager for Finland in 2026; the only other relevant fact concerns Google’s existing country manager, not a new hire in 2026.

context.content:
To mitigate the counterparty and operational risks inherent in third-party development, Nebius is shifting future capacity additions toward owned-and-operated sites. The company’s expansion roadmap focuses on scaling proprietary sites, including a second facility in Mäntsälä and new development in Lappeenranta, Finland, alongside domestic US campus developments in Missouri and Alabama. As facilities expand to multi-hundred-megawatt scales, the environmental footprint and power grid interactions become critical operational factors, directly impacting institutional evaluations of compute carbon footprint when accounting for large-scale training workloads.

## Implications for University Research Computing and Procurement [...] AI cloud infrastructure provider Nebius Group announced on November 12, 2026, an ambitious capital expenditure roadmap projecting between $40 billion and $45 billion in planned infrastructure spending for 2027 to aggressively expand its global graphics processing unit (GPU) clusters and data centre operations. The planned investment follows a revision of its full-year 2026 capital expenditure target to approximately $27 billion, reflecting accelerating industrial demand for specialized artificial intelligence model training and inference capacity. Nebius aims to surpass one gigawatt of operational power capacity across its facilities to serve hyperscale clients and enterprise foundation model developers.

context.content:
NBIS analyst ratings

Nebius Group posted third-quarter revenue of $980.8 million, topping the $907.2 million consensus estimate. Of that total, Nebius Group disclosed $325 million came from non-recurring activity tied to the initial phase of an asset-light partnership. Without that item, revenue would have landed below the consensus.

Management said Nebius Group now expects 2026 revenue at the low end of its prior $3 billion to $3.4 billion range because third-party colocation deliveries slipped, with New Jersey phases pushed to Q2 2027. At the same time, Nebius Group raised its 2026 capital expenditure forecast to approximately $27 billion. “The changes in our 2026 guidance are just about timing, not demand,” the chief financial officer stated on the earnings call. [...] Nebius runs a full-stack AI cloud that pairs owned data centers in Finland, Missouri and Alabama with leased colocation space in the U.S., Europe, Israel and India. Through Token Factory it sells managed inference, and it owns side businesses including the Avride robotaxi and delivery-robot unit and the TripleTen education platform. That colocation layer is where the current delays sit. [...] Wall Street is losing patience with the data center expansion timeline at Nebius Group (NASDAQ:NBIS | NBIS Price Prediction). Nebius stock is at $111.34 in morning trading, down 13%. That drop compounds a steep stretch, leaving Nebius stock down 46% over the past month.

Two Wall Street firms cut their price targets on Nebius on November 13, citing delays in activating third-party data center capacity. The reset follows the company’s Q3 2026 report on November 12, which paired a revenue beat with a trimmed 2026 outlook and a bigger spending plan.
